account.title: Your account
account.demoNote: This is a demo account. Once you sign out you cannot come back to this demo club.

sample.title: Load the sample season
sample.body: Fill this demo club with an invented under-13 season: 14 players with nicknames, 3 matches and 5 training sessions. Every screen then has something to show. It is deleted with the demo club after a week.
sample.failed: The sample season could not be loaded, so nothing was added. Try again.
sample.notEmpty: The squad already has players, so nothing was added.
sample.done: Sample season loaded. Players: {{players}}, matches: {{matches}}, sessions: {{sessions}}.
sample.writing: Adding the squad, three matches and five training sessions…

squad.title: Squad
squad.subtitle: A player is only a nickname and a shirt number.
squad.caption: Squad of {{team}}
squad.readOnly: Only the club's owner and coaches can change the squad. You can see it here.

empty.title: No players yet
empty.body: Add your first player. A nickname and a shirt number are enough.
empty.bodyReadOnly: No players have been added yet. The club's owner or a coach can add them.

form.label: Label
form.labelHint: A nickname or initials. Please do not enter a full name.
form.shirtHint: From 1 to 99. Each active player needs a different number.
form.consentHint: Record whether a parent or guardian agreed to the child being in Klupa. No document is stored, only the status and the date you set it.
form.quarterHint: Only the quarter is stored, never a birth date. It is used to check whether younger-born players get a fair share.

errors.shirtInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 99.
errors.shirtConflict: That shirt number was just taken. Pick another.

archive.title: Archive {{label}}?
archive.body: {{label}} leaves the squad list and shirt number {{number}} becomes free again. Their minutes, events, attendance and observations stay in the history.

erase.title: Erase {{label}} permanently?
erase.intro: This removes {{label}} from Klupa for good.

removed.identity: The label, shirt number, consent status and birth quarter

erase.kept: Match events (shots, chances, recoveries). They lose the link to this player, so team results and charts do not change.

settings.title: Club settings
settings.subtitle: The name of your club and the figures behind facility estimates.
settings.ownerOnly: Only the club's owner can change these settings. You can see them here.
settings.name: Club name
settings.facilityIntro: Optional. Every cost and carbon figure for the facility in Klupa is an estimate built from these three numbers. It is not a measurement.
settings.useReference: Use Bosnia and Herzegovina reference values
settings.referenceNote: Fills in the price and the carbon intensity. Floodlight power depends on your lights, so enter it yourself.
settings.floodlightKwHint: The total power of the lights you switch on for training.
settings.sourcePrice: Reference source: BHAS, electricity prices for small non-household users, second half of 2025
settings.carbon: Grid carbon intensity (kg CO₂ per kWh)
settings.sourceCarbon: Reference source: Ember via Our World in Data, 2025

errors.decimalInvalid: Enter a number of 0 or more, for example 0.30.
errors.decimalTooLarge: Use a value of {{max}} or less.

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.subtitle: Klupa is built to hold as little about children as possible.

stored.title: What Klupa stores
stored.players: For each player: a label you choose and a shirt number.
stored.quarter: Optionally, the quarter of the year a player was born in.
stored.consent: Whether a guardian has given consent, and the date you set it.
stored.activity: What happens in matches and training: match events, minutes on the pitch, attendance, effort ratings and observation counts.
stored.never: Klupa does not store names, birth dates, photos, contact details or health records.

where.title: Where it is kept
where.body: The data is hosted in the European Union, in Frankfurt. Database rules let only members of this club read or change its data.

kept.title: How long it is kept
kept.events: Match events you undo are deleted for good after 30 days.
kept.log: The activity log is deleted after one year.
kept.demo: Demo clubs are deleted after one week.

privacy.ownerOnly: Only the club's owner can download or delete the club's data.

export.title: Download a copy
export.body: Everything this club holds, as one JSON file you can keep or move elsewhere. Each download is recorded below.

delete.title: Delete this club
delete.body: This deletes the club and everything in it: players, matches, sessions and the activity log. It cannot be undone. Download a copy first if you may need it.
delete.sheetBody: Everything in this club will be deleted for good: players, matches, events, sessions, attendance, observations and the activity log. This cannot be undone.
delete.typeLabel: Type the club name to confirm
delete.typeHint: Type {{club}} exactly as it is written.
delete.mismatch: That does not match the club name.

activity.title: Activity log
activity.subtitle: The newest 100 changes in this club.
activity.note: The log records which fields changed and never their values, so it holds no personal data.
activity.caption: Changes, newest first
activity.restricted: Only the club's owner and coaches can see the activity log.

empty.title: Nothing logged yet
empty.body: Changes to the squad, matches and sessions will appear here.
